[mysqld]
datadir=/srv/mysql/data
socket=/srv/mysql/run/mysqld.sock
pid-file=/srv/mysql/run/mysqld.pid
port=25060
bind-address=*
report_host=10.0.0.1
server_id=167772161
gtid_mode=ON
enforce_gtid_consistency=ON
log_bin=binlog
binlog_expire_logs_seconds=604800
ssl_ca=/srv/mysql/tls/ca.crt
ssl_cert=/srv/mysql/tls/server.crt
ssl_key=/srv/mysql/tls/server.key
tls_version=TLSv1.2,TLSv1.3
plugin-load-add=mysql_clone.so
performance_schema=ON
performance-schema-consumer-statements-digest=ON
back_log=256
innodb_buffer_pool_size=2560M
innodb_io_capacity=2000
innodb_io_capacity_max=4000
innodb_log_buffer_size=16M
innodb_open_files=4000
innodb_page_cleaners=1
innodb_parallel_read_threads=1
innodb_purge_threads=1
innodb_read_io_threads=4
innodb_redo_log_capacity=640M
innodb_write_io_threads=4
max_connections=256
open_files_limit=65536
table_open_cache=4000
table_open_cache_instances=2
temptable_max_ram=122M
thread_cache_size=10
!includedir /srv/mysql/conf/conf.d
